cases.title: Tatsächliche erste Produktion und Front
steps: Use physical roof supplies, target/material cycling and interaction hold.
Craft 2 sand + 1 finite binder into 2 concrete; 2 ore or scrap into 2 steel.
Collect finished outputs and build story front wall with 2 steel + 2 concrete; cure normally.
Mount a weapon, defend and refill finite ammunition; build early supply gallery normally.
cases.expected: Player understands tap/hold, finite ingredients, pickup-before-new-batch, front defense and real refill; no observer rescue or added resources.

cases.title: Modalfokus und getragene Ladung
steps: Carry real materials; open options, handbook, friends, chat, confirmations and report.
Navigate Tab/Shift+Tab, arrows/D-pad, scroll, Enter/A and Esc/B.
Attempt movement, fire, T/P/F5 and B while child modal is open.
cases.expected: All visible controls remain reachable; child closes before parent, focus returns to opener, carried quantities unchanged and no underlying gameplay action.

cases.title: Fenster/Vollbild und Gerätewechsel
steps: Launch native extracted candidate outside source folder.
Toggle F11 and option fullscreen; change resolution and renderer with required restart.
Reconnect physical controller and change output device.
cases.expected: No quit/crash, missing dependency or unreadable controls; restart and saved configuration remain consistent.

cases.title: Echte Lobby, Freunde und Chat
steps: Create/join matching candidate room.
Select guest actions; exchange and confirm a friend request on both sides.
Use mute/block, text and quick messages; close subdialogs.
cases.expected: Host authority, disable reasons, confirmations and return focus are clear; text entry blocks motion/fire/PTT; no involuntary material drop.

cases.title: Native Hostwechsel über zwei Internetanschlüsse
steps: Use physical native Linux and Windows devices across two genuine internet connections.
Swap host and guest, start, travel, pause/reconnect and rematch.
Test wrong/version-invalid join and cancel/retry without disclosing code.
cases.expected: Peers see correct status and usable next steps; healthy guests remain connected; matches use same build.

cases.title: LAN-Suche zwischen zwei Geräten
steps: Use two physical devices on same LAN.
Discover, join and leave/rejoin the room.
cases.expected: Discovery and correct joined crew are visible; local adapter simulation is not counted.

cases.title: Reguläre Niederlage und Wiederaufnahme
steps: Record finite materials/ammunition at a secured mission beginning.
Suffer actual defeat; retry and restart application using normal UI.
cases.expected: Saved mission beginning is restored without new rewards, materials or ammo; no blocked progression.

cases.title: Koop-Stand offline fortsetzen
steps: Save a real secured cooperative progression.
Leave network, relaunch and continue offline through normal UI.
cases.expected: Only own offline player exists; parked former crew does not remain active; real resource quantities and progress preserved.

cases.title: Natürliche Solopanne mit Deckung
steps: Drive regular harbor route after visible boarding.
At the actual puncture choose player repair or SAN-1 repair with no patient waiting.
Perform jack/remove/fit/three bolts/lower; test hold/timing miss and interruption; reboard and continue.
cases.expected: Two real solo escorts defend with finite ammo; medical needs override SAN-1 repair; mechanic receives real threats and five-step task completes with appropriate art/audio.

cases.title: Natürliche Kooppanne und Rollenwechsel
steps: Reach regular tire puncture with real cooperative crew.
Assign one rear-wheel mechanic; remaining players defend vehicle and mechanic.
Change mechanic, interrupt a step, complete all five steps and reboard.
cases.expected: One operator owns each repair step; second hand does not accelerate it; finite participant weapons actually fire/reload; all clients see repair and continued route.

cases.title: SAN-1 Medizin, Transport und Bergung
steps: Unlock SAN-1 transport and collection with legitimately earned tech points.
Offer real machine inputs, finished output, compatible storage and injured worker.
cases.expected: Medicine takes priority, finished products are cleared, actual material moves once into reachable storage and no invented resources.

cases.title: Freischaltungen im normalen Spiel
steps: Earn personal character levels 2/4/6/8/10 through real play.
Check own unlocked moves, shared level-1 moves and unavailable foreign styles.
Restart actual program and verify entitlement.
cases.expected: Five character-specific moves unlock at character thresholds and persist; lab preview alone does not establish entitlement.

cases.title: Kick, volle Arme und direkte Übernahme
steps: At normal zoom observe kick-free melodic intro and real kick entry for each figure.
Carry actual materials while idle; then walk/jump/climb/interact/fire or encounter actual close threat/hit.
Observe same-world threat cancellation and independently running Music-Lab preview.
cases.expected: Head/shoulder/feet accent matches audible kick; carried load keeps grip/quantity with only head nod; action/danger immediately overrides dance; unrelated world does not cancel lab.

cases.title: Phasen, Übergänge und Wiederholung
steps: Observe character default selection with multiple legitimately learned moves.
Follow at least several 16-beat changes, tempo/intensity/style transitions and reduced motion.
cases.expected: Transitions remain legible and continuous; no immediate repeated auto move when multiple are learned; planted soles and side view remain appropriate.

cases.title: SAN-1 Bunkerdance I–V
steps: Research all five available Bunkerdance stages through real tech progression.
Observe idle beat movement and switch to healing, repair and logistics.
cases.expected: Five researched dances are distinct and interrupt for urgent tasks; medical/logistics cargo preserved.

cases.title: Frische 50%-Standards
steps: Start fresh dedicated profile without copied saved audio preferences.
Open audio options; hear music, impacts/shots, spoken lines and real partner speech.
cases.expected: Music/effects/dialogue/partner controls are 50%; authored unequal internal balance is retained, intelligible and comfortable.

cases.title: Vorhandene Laboroberfläche
steps: Open Options rhythm tab and Music-Lab.
Compare theme, genre, BPM, seed, music tension and dance preferences; stop/restart preview.
Compare preview-only and explicitly applied preferences.
cases.expected: Existing controls act visibly/audibly; preview does not alter running match silently; no synthesis FX slider is claimed.

cases.title: Synthese-Dry/Wet menschlich hören
steps: Use documented paired dry/wet WAVs from music-dance/index.html at identical hardware volume.
Compare same music/seed in quiet and combat for minimal techno, schranz, hip-hop and breakbeat.
cases.expected: Describe actual perceived reverb/delay difference and usefulness without conflating it with bus DSP or lab gain.

cases.title: Tatsächliche Godot-Bus-FX
steps: Use private source/project/audio-layout copy in Godot 4.7.2.
Run actual audio and compare Music/SFX PitchShift bypass/on at reasonable unchanged volume.
Adjust the real effect parameter; discard private test modifications.
cases.expected: Human hears relevant bus parameter/bypass difference; result is separate from synthesis dry/wet and ordinary volume controls.
cases.requires: Godot 4.7.2 plus matching private source copy

cases.title: Vollständiger Paketinhalt
steps: Check exact BUILD_INFO and SHA256; extract all files and run without source/Godot.
Visit music, spoken languages, unlocked figures, travel, social and options.
Inspect supplied provenance/license files.
cases.expected: No missing dynamic asset/library; exact candidate identified; no old/new archive mixing.

cases.title: Lokaler technischer Fehlerbericht
steps: Open F4 > Fehlerbericht from menu and paused world.
Refresh, copy explicitly and save explicitly; parse/check actual local JSON.
Close inner and parent dialogs using all input routes.
cases.expected: Actual app/engine/platform/runtime renderer/UTC and selected mode/location present; no automatic upload, raw logs, chat, names, addresses, codes or secrets; focus/return and offline pause correct.

cases.title: Modus, gesicherte Kampagne und Reisefehler
steps: Collect report in actual free shift with active shared campaign container, selected story, regular travel and actual failed journey.
cases.expected: Selected story/free_shift is independent of campaign_active; real loaded location, phase and failed travel stage correctly identified.

cases.title: Verständlicher lokaler Speicherfehler
steps: Use only supervisor-prepared unwritable private test destination.
Request explicit local save, observe error, then refresh/close normally.
cases.expected: Clear save failure; no claimed success, crash, upload or stuck modal.
cases.requires: Prepared private unwritable report destination; do not alter personal system permissions

cases.title: Oskar bewusst auslassen und sicher erneut besuchen
steps: In regular solo story skip Oskar, clear Basaltbruch, depart normally.
Choose secured Basaltbruch on map; transport actual 2 concrete and recruit in person.
Revisit again and restart program.
cases.expected: Recruitment succeeds without second defense; entitlement persists, no duplicate material charge, starter roof stock, XP, blueprint or stop reward.

cases.expected: Recruitment succeeds without second defense; entitlement persists, no duplicate material charge, starter roof stock, XP, blueprint or stop reward.
